en: A person on the sofa watches the armor drop into the inventory on their phone. Beside them, on a small table, sits the open box of a pair of shoes bought at an ordinary store. Both purchases carry the same weight in the scene.
planned illustration · direito-a

Two hands hold a phone with a game store on the screen. The buy button is huge, the armor shines and an hourglass runs in the corner. The way to the terms is a gray line, almost invisible, at the bottom.
planned illustration · direito-b

The same person appears twice. On the left, facing a roll of paper that pours out of the phone and piles up on the floor. On the right, holding a small card with three clear signs, a clock, an arrow of change and a crossed-out item.
planned illustration · direito-c
A street billboard shows the armor surrounded by lightning and sparks. Under it, a person opens their phone and sees the same armor with no effects at all, dull, and looks from one to the other.
planned illustration · direito-d

Footprints in the snow cross a courtyard to a shop window where the armor has changed shape. A broom coming out of a side door sweeps some of them away, and a person follows the ones left with a phone in hand.
planned illustration · direito-e
A market scale balances the old armor and the new one, with different designs and the same weight. A person checks the needle up close, and the shadow of the old armor stays on the wall.
planned illustration · direito-f
A person is locked outside a glass door with a big padlock, and inside their armor hangs in a cabinet. They press the doorbell, and the wire loops around and comes back to the button itself.
planned illustration · direito-g
A line of people holding coins waits in front of a claw machine. The armor sits high up, out of reach, and the mechanism shows from inside, set to let go, while the coin jar overflows.
planned illustration · direito-h

On the left, a person at the kitchen table with screenshots and a phone. On the right, a records room behind a grille, with boxes on high shelves. Between the two, a judge's hand points at the grille, asking for it to open.
planned illustration · direito-i

In a studio, people wear the armor they bought inside a large painted canvas. The artist, who owns the work, raises a cloth to cover the whole canvas, and a dashed frame around the people shows what is not only theirs to cover.
planned illustration · direito-j
Two restorer's hands in thin gloves fit the broken pieces of the armor back together on a table, guided by a sheet with the drawing of the whole armor. A person watches from the doorway.
planned illustration · direito-k
